headline: IDP Approves $200 Million Investment Guarantee for Argentine Electrical Grid
summary: The IDB approved a $200 million guarantee to expand two electrical corridors in Argentina, benefiting 16 million users.
why: Multilateral development bank financing supports essential regional infrastructure projects and boosts long-term productivity.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Infrastructure guarantees facilitate capital expenditure and grid expansion.
